title: Load an inventory CSV
hints: csv.DictReader(f) yields one dict per row keyed by the header; reader.fieldnames gives the header so you can check the required columns before looping.
Every cell is a string. Wrap int(...) and float(...) in try/except ValueError and `continue` on failure.
Short rows put None in the missing keys; long rows add a key of None. Check `None in row` and `row.get(k) is None` to spot both.
